tool_args.rationale: The W2 thermal-fin bridge and flux-conservation signatures support the inland-hub siphon family, but current rows hold s_grad fixed at 1 and cannot resolve the open branch contribution. The targeted open-branch probe is the relevant low-cost measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a node_C/node_D two-layer siphon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five rows have the same sink gradient, leaving the branch term and gradient-inhibition contribution insufficiently identifiable; the archive specifically calls for an open-branch probe when gradient span is below 0.08.
The evidence points to the W2 thermal-fin bridge mapping to the static node_C siphon, not a memory ODE requiring trajectory rows.
It does not discriminate the identified branch ambiguity and should not be purchased.
